page.layout: One page of running text in a single full-width column. Running head at top, page number at top right. No marginal notes. Catchword at bottom right. A stamp at bottom left is not transcribed.

main_text.p: solutum est. Quo perfecto aliam fossam parem fodit, non multum à priore disiunctam, spectantem ad mediterranea: addiditque duas praterea alias istis similes, & circumpositas, ita ut totum opus fossionis fieret quadrangulum, omnesque ejus partes muniit vallis acutis: & post vallos fossas altas vallumq; castrensi duxit. Ea vero parte, qua Carthaginem spectabat, murum etiam extruxit xxv stadiorum longitudine, altitudine pedum xii, praeter propugnacula & turres, quae per intervalla muro imminebant: latitudo seu crassities muri dimidium altitudinis aquabat. In medio turris erant altissima tecta quadruplici fastigio ligneo, unde despicere licebat ea, quae in urbe fierent. His operibus totius exercitus labore absolutis intra dies noctesque viginti quatuor, militibus vicissim nunc arma tenentibus nunc opus facientibus, nec cibum nec somnium nisi necessarium capientibus, in his castris collocavit copias: praebuitque ei hoc opus tum castrorum usum, tum munitionum contra hostes extensarum. Hinc enim erumpens commeatum, qui à terra iis afferebatur, Carthaginiensibus adimebat. Nam hac sola cervice exceptâ reliqua omnis urbs undiq; circumluebatur. Atque haec prima, ac maximè famis malorumque causa ob-sessi.

page.notes: The catchword "sessi." is the second part of the word hyphenated at the line end "ob-" and is set apart at the foot right. The word "quae" before "in urbe" is printed with a space that is hard to read ("quain"); it is read as "quae". Italic/roman boundaries in the first lines are uncertain; italics are marked from "Ea vero" to the end. Faint marks at the left edge and a stamp at bottom left are not transcribed.
